ValidationRule.description: Only allows users to change status to SWL, SQL, Marketing Only, Nurture, or Disqualified. SAL-2335. Updated to exclude Brette/Kim
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'B - Marketo Integration', $User.User_LongID__c <> '005f2000009yztxAAA', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000AFZm6QAH', NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Contact_Status__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Contact_Status__c))), TEXT(Contact_Status__c)<>"SWL (Sales Working Lead)", TEXT(Contact_Status__c)<>"SQL (Sales Qualified Lead)", TEXT(Contact_Status__c)<>"Marketing Only", TEXT(Contact_Status__c)<>"Nurture", TEXT(Contact_Status__c)<>"Disqualified" ) && Contact_Automation_Bypassed__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only update the status to SWL, SQL, Marketing Only, Nurture, or Disqualified.
